Our Story

About High on Food

Fresh home-style tiffins and a daily meal kitchen, serving Indiranagar, Bengaluru.

Every meal at High on Food is cooked fresh in our kitchen, the way it would be at home, with zero preservatives. Whether you want a tiffin sent out each morning or evening, we cook it the same day and dispatch it on time.

Home-style food, cooked fresh every day.

Made for professionals, students and anyone missing a homely meal.

Quick answers

When do you dispatch?

Morning tiffins go out at 8 AM and evening tiffins at 7 PM.

Are you open every day?

Yes, Monday to Sunday, 7:30 AM to 10:30 PM.

Do you use preservatives?

No. Everything is cooked fresh with zero preservatives.

Do you have weekly and monthly plans?

Yes. Both are available with morning, evening or both meals.

How do I order?

Message us on WhatsApp or call +91 91028 65869.
